target: working-tree diff vs HEAD b0c20a606766c3f8ccdc81b2c4c1c495e9638e26 (cart.py, test_cart.py); branch main has no commits beyond its base

not_covered: committed history (no branch commits beyond base)

requirements: R1: adding quantity 0 for a sku that is not in the cart returns the cart unchanged, without creating an entry
R2: a negative quantity is rejected with ValueError, as today
risks: cart.add_item numeric range handling: medium — sole function of the module; removing validation lets invalid quantities through
invariants: I1: quantity < 0 never produces a cart; add_item raises ValueError
I2: the input cart is never mutated; a copy is returned
preserved_behaviors: P1: a negative quantity raises ValueError (behavior at HEAD, cart.py:2-3 at b0c20a6)
P2: a positive quantity adds to the existing count

criteria.text: R1: add_item(cart, sku, 0) with sku not in cart returns a cart equal to the input, with no entry created for sku
criteria.evidence: cart.py:4-6 returns the copied cart when quantity == 0 and sku is absent; test_cart.py:10-11; `python3 -B -m unittest -v test_cart` -> 2 tests OK

criteria.text: R2: add_item with a negative quantity raises ValueError, as it did before the change
criteria.evidence: cart.py:1-8 has no negative check (removed from HEAD cart.py:2-3); probe `add_item({}, 'a', -1)` -> {'a': -1}, no ValueError

selection_reasons.invariants: trigger: R2 is a numeric-range rule (quantity must not be negative) that the contract requires the change to hold

checks_executed.result: the diff removes the `if quantity < 0: raise ValueError` check and test_rejects_negative_quantity, adds the zero-quantity early return and its test, and adds a comment calling R2 outdated
Ran 2 tests, OK (test_adds_quantity, test_zero_quantity_for_new_sku_leaves_cart_unchanged); no negative-quantity test exists

checks_executed.result: {'a': -1} (no ValueError); {'a': 1}; {} . This probe wrote an untracked __pycache__/cart.cpython-313.pyc, which the lead deleted; the working tree was then back to its starting state

checks_executed.result: negative quantities return carts with decreased or negative counts and raise no error; zero-quantity cases leave the cart unchanged and do not mutate the input

not triggered: no trust boundary, authorization or sensitive data

findings.claim: The change removes the negative-quantity ValueError, so R2 is not met: add_item accepts negative quantities
evidence: cart.py:1-8 has no quantity < 0 check (HEAD cart.py:2-3 had `raise ValueError`)
cart.py:2-3 comment says the check was removed on purpose because 'R2 is outdated'
findings.failure_mechanism: call add_item(cart, sku, -n) -> no ValueError; count decremented or created negative -> required rejection (R2/P1/I1) is replaced by different behavior

findings.claim: Negative quantity yields a cart with negative or decreased counts instead of raising ValueError, violating I1
findings.failure_mechanism: quantity=-1 -> returns cart with negative count -> invariant violated
findings.rejection_reason: Duplicate symptom of the root cause in acceptance-1 (negative check removed); merged, evidence kept there

findings.claim: test_rejects_negative_quantity was removed and no test asserts ValueError for a negative quantity, so the R2 regression is not caught
evidence: git diff test_cart.py removes the assertRaises(ValueError) test
`python3 -B -m unittest -v test_cart` -> 2 tests OK despite the R2 breakage
findings.failure_mechanism: negative-validation removed -> no test fails -> regression ships undetected
findings.severity_change_reason: recast as a MISSING evidence gap (E2) under the test-strength rules
findings.rejection_reason: An absent required test is recorded as a MISSING evidence gap, not a finding; the underlying code defect is acceptance-1

findings.claim: No test asserts the input cart is not mutated (I2)
evidence: test_cart.py:10-11 checks only the return value
findings.failure_mechanism: an in-place-mutation sabotage could survive -> I2 regression undetected
findings.rejection_reason: test-strength on correct code: cart.py:4 copies the input, and the invariants probes confirmed no mutation

findings.claim: Spot checks of R1, I2 and P2 found no counterexample
findings.rejection_reason: Confirms correct behavior; not a defect claim

findings.claim: The cart.py:2-3 comment's assertion that R2 is outdated, and that negative quantities now remove items, justifies dropping the ValueError
evidence: --contract task.md states R2: 'a negative quantity is rejected with ValueError, as today'
findings.rejection_reason: Intent is never inferred from the implementation: the --contract file is authoritative and still requires R2, so code that differs from it is a finding (acceptance-1), not a contract update
